subject: Sponsorship & Trial Credits — Terra Accelerator cohort (commitment)
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@terraaccelerator.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Terra Accelerator Ops <ops@terraaccelerator.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsorship request — Terra Accelerator cohort, June 2027

Hi Ben and Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the founders loved the latency and cost breakdowns you showed. Terra is finalizing the resource packages for our June cohort and we'd like to request a sponsorship from Redwood: 1) $15,000 in platform credits (redeemable over 6 months) and 2) a 3-month trial extension on top of our standard 30-day trial so the teams can complete their integrations.

Attached is our standard sponsorship request (Terra_Sponsorship_Request.pdf) with cohort dates and expected usage profiles. The cohort kicks off on June 10 and most teams will be doing heavy inference tests in weeks 2–6.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to the credit amount and the extension? If yes, we'll send a short confirmation letter and list Redwood as a sponsor on our website (logo & blurb). If you require a PO or a signed commitment, we can route that through our procurement team.

Thanks — we typically need partner confirmations two weeks before kickoff (ideally by May 27).

Best,
Elena
Director, Partnerships
Terra Accelerator

---
Attachment: Terra_Sponsorship_Request.pdf (application form, cohort usage table)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Sponsorship request — Terra Accelerator cohort, June 2027

Laura / Monica — forwarding Terra's ask. Quick summary: request for $15k in credits + 3-month trial extension for cohort starting June 10. They asked for confirmation by May 27.

Key items to confirm:
- Can we approve $15k promo credits against usage (6-month expiry)?
- Are we comfortable with the 3-month extension on free trial for cohort participants? This is higher than our standard 30-day window but it's limited to program participants and we can gate by company domain + HubSpot deal record.
- Any special SLAs or additional legal review required? They mentioned procurement/POs.

I'm fine doing the external confirmation if we have approval from finance/legal. Monica, can you confirm if the credits can be issued as a promotional coupon applied at account creation (HubSpot flow) and whether this needs an order form? Laura — if you can sign off today, I can draft the commitment letter and route for e-signature.

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sponsorship request — Terra Accelerator cohort, June 2027

Ben / Monica — I'm fine approving this at the level requested with the following conditions:

1) Credits: $15,000 in promotional credits, valid for 6 months from issuance, non-transferable, applied via HubSpot promo code tied to company domain and deal (RDW-2027-TERRA-001).
2) Extension: 3-month trial extension for cohort participants, limited to companies enrolled in Terra's June cohort (we will validate via Terra roster).
3) Legal/Finance: include standard sponsorship language (no revenue recognition impact; credits are contra-revenue). Monica, please confirm whether we need an internal GL code or a PO to attach to the HubSpot deal. If finance needs it, route the short commitment as an SOW-style addendum.
4) Marketing: Ben — you can confirm public sponsor placement after we receive Terra's logo and the signed commitment.

If Monica confirms the GL/PO requirements, I approve. Ben, you can send an external commitment (signed PDF + DocuSign) and CC procurement if Terra asks for a PO.

—Laura
VP, Growth & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 May 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship & Trial Credits — Terra Accelerator cohort (commitment)

Hi Elena — great to hear from you. Happy to confirm Redwood will sponsor Terra's June cohort under the terms below:

- Credits: $15,000 in Redwood promotional credits, redeemable over 6 months from issuance, applied at account creation and tied to the company domain / HubSpot deal RDW-2027-TERRA-001.
- Trial extension: cohort participants will receive a 3-month trial window (in addition to the standard account setup period) — limited to companies listed on Terra's official roster.
- Logistics: we'll send a short commitment letter (PDF) and an e-sign DocuSign link. If your procurement requires a PO, please send it to ops@terraaccelerator.com and we'll attach it to the HubSpot deal.

I've attached the commitment PDF (Redwood_Sponsorship_Commitment.pdf) and shared a DocuSign link for signature: https://www.docusign.com/link/abc123-redwood-terra

Next steps for Terra:
1) Please confirm the roster (company list) by May 27.
2) Sign the DocuSign commitment (link above) or reply with procurement PO if needed.
3) Send logo and sponsor blurb for the cohort page once signed.

Looking forward to partnering — Ben will follow up with the HubSpot promo code once the signed commitment is complete.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_Sponsorship_Commitment.pdf (1 page — credit schedule, terms)
